description.value: Painter's Lodge is a historic waterfront fishing and nature lodge on the shores of Campbell River, with a legacy of hosting Hollywood icons and legendary anglers since its early days. The property offers standard rooms, lofts, suites, private cabins, and a full house, all with Pacific Northwest ocean or garden views. On-site amenities include a restaurant, bar, heated outdoor pool, tennis court, mobile sauna, and a marine center offering whale watching, grizzly bear tours, fishing charters, and scuba diving.

address.value: 1625 McDonald Rd, Campbell River, BC V9W 4S5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the lodge identity, address, phone, and amenities. Free WiFi is confirmed in room listings ('Free WiFi' listed under standard room amenities) and corroborated by OSM internet_access=wlan. The amenities page lists a restaurant and bar on-site, confirming nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, tools, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific services appears anywhere on the website, so those fields are null. A minor address discrepancy exists: the contact page header shows postcode V0N 3A6 while the footer and all other pages consistently show V9W 4S5, matching OSM.
concerns: Postcode inconsistency within the website itself: the contact page header shows V0N 3A6, but the footer on all pages (including the contact page) and OSM both show V9W 4S5. V9W 4S5 is used as authoritative.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Painter's Lodge is a legitimate, operating full-service hotel on Vancouver Island and a touring cyclist could stay here, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) is confirmed anywhere on the website. A direct inquiry about cycling accommodations is needed before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website footer states: 'Please note, there are no accessible guest rooms at our hotel. Accessible amenities are only located in the main building's common areas.' Pet policy: maximum 2 pets per room, non-refundable charge per pet per night; service animals welcome.
